item.tib: pad ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud g+hu ru drag po rje gur khang las khyung gi dbang khrid gsang dbang ye shes me dpung
item.coloph: de ltar gsang dbang 'dus pa 'di/ yum cig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la rgyud (brgyud) pa yin/ dge legs 'phel//

item.tib: pad+ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud g+hu ru drag po rdo rje'i gur khang las khyung gi dbang khrid gsang dbang ye shes me dpung
item.coloph: de ltar gsang dbang 'dus pa 'di/ yum cig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa'o//
